application_observation.basis: The ending call rejected after the proxy dropped the COMMIT reply: Connection terminated unexpectedly

interpretation.note: The proxy forwards COMMIT, then closes the client socket before the client parses ReadyForQuery. The second connection can still see the database outcome. The client cannot.

boundary_basis: The client did not receive the acknowledgment. The application reported a failure or uncertainty, rather than a successful commit or a confirmed rollback.

evidence.statement: pg_xact_status() committed, marker visible true, session absent, xid 35438.

limits: Java and .NET are not installed in this environment, so pgjdbc and Npgsql were not executed.
The system Python has no psycopg module, so psycopg was not executed.
No packet capture. A server command tag is inferred only when a driver command tag was observed.
TX-02's missing savepoint name and TX-03's withheld ROLLBACK are client-side injections.
